A song of ascents. In my distress I cried to the LORD, and He answered me.
In my trouble my cry went up to the Lord, and he gave me an answer.
（上行（或作登階，下同）之詩。）我在急難中求告耶和華，他就應允我。
Deliver my soul, O LORD, from lying lips and a deceitful tongue.
O Lord, be the saviour of my soul from false lips, and from the tongue of deceit.
耶和華啊，求你救我脫離說謊的嘴唇和詭詐的舌頭！
What will He do to you, and what will be added to you, O deceitful tongue?
What punishment will he give you? what more will he do to you, you false tongue?
詭詐的舌頭啊，要給你甚麼呢？要拿甚麼加給你呢？
Sharp arrows will come from the warrior, with burning coals of the broom tree!
Sharp arrows of the strong, and burning fire.
就是勇士的利箭和羅騰木（小樹名，松類）的炭火。
Woe to me that I dwell in Meshech, that I live among the tents of Kedar!
Sorrow is mine because I am strange in Meshech, and living in the tents of Kedar.
我寄居在米設，住在基達帳棚之中，有禍了！
Too long have I dwelt among those who hate peace.
My soul has long been living with the haters of peace.
我與那恨惡和睦的人許久同住。
I am in favor of peace; but when I speak, they want war.
I am for peace: but when I say so, they are for war.
我願和睦，但我發言，他們就要爭戰。
